7540.title: Sidebar usage scroll reachability
7540.rootCauseOneLine: Existing quota scrolling works at normal heights; fixed 20rem disclosure sizing clips the outer card in a 320px layout harness below desktop minimum height.
7540.proposedFix: First capture the supported Windows case; if outer sizing is confirmed, constrain the host disclosure to available sidebar height.
7540.caveats: Linux source-level layout harness only, not a full Windows desktop run. Clipping occurs only at 320 CSS pixels, below the 600px desktop minimum; normal-height scrolling succeeds.
